svg.title: From the car to occupant protection
svg.desc: The 2010 2.9 places its occupants between the reinforced windscreen frame and two fixed rear bars. Belts, seat and door modules surround the two seats; front modules sit in the wheel and dashboard. Follow structural supports and the three-point belt anchorages, then distinguish two front, two seat-thorax and two door-head airbag modules. The bags stay folded inside their housings. Numbered parts: 1 Body supports; 2 Reinforced windscreen frame; 3 Fixed rear bars; 4 Seats and runners; 5 Three-point belts; 6 Two front modules; 7 Two thorax modules; 8 Two door head modules. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
